description: One visible character notices and repairs a loose model bridge support.

session.personaDescription: A patient craftsperson in a quiet workshop.

interactions.content: I set the brass support beneath the model bridge and test it with one fingertip.
In the sunlit workshop, Mara notices the miniature bridge sagging, slides a brass support beneath its center, and holds still as the span settles level.

characters.name: Mara
characters.description: A patient craftsperson in a quiet workshop.

requiredSourceFacts.description: The brass support is beneath the bridge center.
